units.source_text: 发长彦听完他们的话，觉得自己的机会来了，

en.t: After Kaminaga-hiko finished listening to what they had said, he felt that his chance had come,

units.source_text: 于是马上摸了摸白狗的头，说：“阿嗅，阿嗅，靠你了，

en.t: so he immediately stroked the white dog's head and said, "Akyu, Akyu, I am counting on you,

units.source_text: 你嗅一嗅，看看公主在哪里。”

en.t: sniff around and find out where the princess is."
